exceptions.reason: Build-time only: electron-builder -> app-builder-lib -> @electron/get 3 -> got 11 -> cacheable-request 7. It is not shipped in the app, and got only reaches it when a request sets a cache store, which nothing in that chain does, so there is no shared cache to disclose. No patched release exists, and electron-builder moves to @electron/get 5 (which drops got) only in 27, still alpha.

Build-time only: electron-builder -> app-builder-lib -> @electron/get 3 -> global-agent 3 (optional) -> roarr 2. It is not shipped in the app. @electron/get loads global-agent only when ELECTRON_GET_USE_PROXY is set, which no build or CI step does, and global-agent passes only literal format strings to roarr, so no attacker controls a precision specifier. No patched release exists, and electron-builder moves to @electron/get 5 (which drops global-agent) only in 27, still alpha.

Build-time only: expo 57 -> @expo/metro -> metro-file-map -> micromatch 4 -> braces 3. Metro uses it to match the project's own watch and ignore globs while bundling the mobile app; it is not shipped in the app and never sees untrusted patterns. braces 3.0.3 is the latest release, so no patched version exists.

Build-time only: expo 57 -> @expo/cli (and @expo/code-signing-certificates). The CLI uses it for iOS signing identities and to sign update manifests, neither of which this repository configures; it is not shipped in the app, and the advisory concerns verifying RSA signatures from others. node-forge 1.4.0 is the latest release, so no patched version exists.

Build-time only: expo 57 -> @expo/config-plugins -> xcode 3 -> uuid 7, used when generating native iOS projects (prebuild). The advisory affects v3, v5 and v6 when a buffer is passed; xcode only calls uuid.v4() without one. xcode 3.0.1 is the latest release and requires uuid 7, so no patched combination exists.

Shipped in the mobile app: expo-router 57 -> query-string 7 -> decode-uri-component 0.2. Expo Router decodes the query of links the app opens, so a crafted maestrly:// link could stall the app's JavaScript thread until it is closed; no data is exposed and the bot server is not affected. The fixed 0.5 release is ESM-only and breaks query-string 7, and the fix ships with expo-router 58 (Expo SDK 58), still in beta. Re-evaluate when SDK 58 is stable.
